# Phuket King Muay Thai

> Technique first Muay Thai gym in Kathu, Phuket, Thailand, for complete beginners up to fighters. On a 2,000 m2 lakeside site with its own resort (Pangea Resort, lakeside bungalows), a healthy cafe and a recovery area (herbal sauna, dry sauna, steam room, ice bath, red light). Helps students with the Thailand DTV visa through Muay Thai.

- Address: Kathu, Phuket 83120, Thailand (Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=9002483919313262850)
- Email: hello@phuketking.com
- WhatsApp and phone: +66 61 515 5947
- Website: https://www.phuketking.com/
- Booking training: https://www.phuketking.com/prices
- Rooms at Pangea Resort (book direct): https://www.phuketking.com/book
- DTV visa through Muay Thai: https://www.phuketking.com/dtv

## Class timetable (Thailand time)

- Monday: 08:00 Morning class, Technical focus Kicking, 09:45-10:45 Yoga, Gentle Yoga, 15:30 Fitness + Run for fighters, 16:30 Afternoon class, Technical focus Kicking, 18:30 Evening class, Technical focus Kicking
- Tuesday: 08:00 Morning class, Technical focus Punching, 16:30 Afternoon class, Technical focus Punching, 17:45-18:30 Clinching and fighter techniques, 18:30 Evening class, Technical focus Punching
- Wednesday: 08:00 Morning class, Elbow technique, 09:45-10:45 Yoga, Mindful Flow, 15:30 Fighters fitness + Run, 16:30 Afternoon class, Elbow technique, 18:30 Evening class, Elbow technique
- Thursday: 08:00 Morning class, Knee and teeps technique, 16:30 Afternoon class, Knee and teeps technique, 17:45-18:30 Clinching and Fight techniques, 18:30 Evening class, Knee and teeps technique
- Friday: 08:00 Morning class, Defence technique, 09:45-10:45 Yoga, Stretching and mobility, 15:30 Fighters fitness + Run, 16:30 Afternoon class, Defence technique, 18:30 Evening class, Defence technique
- Saturday: 08:00 Morning class, Sparring technique, 16:30 Afternoon class, Sparring technique, 17:30-18:30 Clinching  and fighter technique with Kru Pot
- Sunday: privates only
